title: サプライチェーンマネジメント
subtitle: Supply Chain Management System
keywords: Through put time 2.Cash flow management 3.Forrester effects 4.Decoupling point 5.Inventory control
educationalGoal: This is a course to improve the practical application skills of the department's learning and educational goals. The supply chain management (SCM) is a product or service from material supply to production, distribution and sales. Connect the supply chain with a network, share sales and demand information, etc. between departments or companies in real time, and manage. It is a management concept that realizes customer satisfaction while increasing the speed and efficiency of the entire business.
advice: SCM can be considered as a world where practice in society is more advanced than academic theoretical systematization. It can be said that SCM is being managed based on SCM as well as internationally active companies. For this reason, it is important to look closely at SCM topics and academic journals issued for the business world. This course is not only for the Faculty's study, but also for those who want to pursue manufacturing and distribution. The report will be created based on specific exercises and case studies to deepen understanding.

The supply chain management (SCM) is a product or service from material supply to production, distribution and sales.     授業の概要および学習上の助言   SCM can be considered as a world where practice in society is more advanced than academic theoretical systematization. It can be said that SCM is being managed based on SCM as well as internationally active companies. This course is not only for the Faculty's study, but also for those who want to pursue manufacturing and distribution.
